title: Export the current drawing as PNG and verify the decoded image matches
goal: A 16 x 16 drawing with a red pixel at (2,3) and a blue one at (8,10) offers a 1x PNG of exactly 16 x 16 pixels and is ready to download; the artwork stays exact.

steps.why: The link drew one red and one blue pixel.
1x exports the canvas at its native size.
The export is ready; this plan does not start the browser download (the file itself is checked outside the App run).
